profile.headline: Platform Engineer, SRE, and DevOps enthusiast
profile.summary:
I love automation. Early on in my career, I began getting tired of the inefficiencies of repetitive, manual work and found myself automating whatever I could using the tools available to me. Since then, I've pursued a career where I can implement and build upon this philosophy professionally.

I'm eager to learn and find myself doing so constantly. I love the opportunities technology has to offer in its ever-evolving nature and find it exciting that I'm able to make my passion a reality.

My experience/skill set generally consists of the following technologies and practices:

- Linux
- AWS
- Kubernetes
- Spinnaker
- Docker
- Terraform
- Python
- Git
- Helm
- Bash
- Gitlab CI
- Jenkins
- Salt/configuration management in general
- RabbitMQ
- Packer
- Vagrant
- CI/CD
- Microservices
- High availability
- Virtualization
- Agile Scrum/Kanban/Scrumban

I'm looking for an opportunity to build and expand upon my skill set. My biggest strength (and the reason I've been able to succeed wherever I've gone) is my hunger and ability to learn. There are many technologies I haven't had a chance to work with yet, but I'm confident in my ability to take new technologies on and I'm excited at the possibility of growing myself while also simultaneously contributing to the success of a technology-minded, progressive company.

positions.title: Senior Staff Platform Enginer / Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
Tech and methodologies used:
- AWS
- EKS
- Kubernetes
- Terraform
- Python 3 and unittest
- Docker
- GitLab CI
- Git
- Spinnaker
- Helm
- Agile Scrum
- CI/CD

Things I do:
- Core member of Kubernetes Delivery Platform team, which develops and support the Kubernetes CI/CD "paved road" used by Developers and SREs
- Provide direct end-user support for the platform and pipeline’s usability, bugs, and feature enhancement requests
- Develop features, enhancements, and bug fixes in the pipeline code (GitLab CI + Python 3)
- Collaborate with stakeholders to promote deployment best practices (independent microservices, software and test versioning as part of SDLC, promotion strategies, etc)
- Enhance Kubernetes by introducing third party software that provides features not included by default in vanilla Kubernetes
- Research and test various container vulnerability scanning and reporting tools.
- Create and maintain extensive documentation for internal pipeline, best practices, deployment processes, and additional supporting tools.

positions.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
Tech and methodologies used:
- AWS
- Salt
- Kubernetes
- Terraform
- Python 2/3
- Docker
- Jenkins
- Gitlab CI
- Git
- Bash
- Spinnaker
- Packer
- Agile Scrumban
- CI/CD

Things I did:
- Served as team's technical lead and SME
- Ensured platform ran stably and reliably while continuously improving tech stack
- Worked with Development teams to troubleshoot and optimize software delivery
- Provided guidance on architectural decisions for critical applications
- Mentored teammates to help them mature as engineers and remove technical bottlenecks in team
- Strongly advocated for the adoption of DevOps culture and methologies
- Led migration of complex and mission critical services from physical datacenters to AWS
- Championed initiative to modernize deployment automation of core services and reduce time to value
- Optimized IaC tool performance to significantly reduce execution times
- Overhauled platform and IaC automation to help simplify environment rebuilds and expansion efforts

positions.title: Linux Systems Administrator
positions.description:
TECHNOLOGIES AND METHODOLOGIES:
- Saltstack and Puppet
- Python, BASH, PowerShell
- Jenkins
- Git
- AWS
- Packer and Vagrant
- JBoss Enterprise Application Platform, Tomcat, and Mule ESB
- Fabric
- AppDynamics
- Globalscape EFT
- Agile Scrum and Kanban

ACHIEVEMENTS:
- SME for Saltstack, Puppet, Git, and Globalscape EFT
- Completed Advanced Python training course
- Completed Puppet Practitioner course
- Globalscape EFT Administration certification
- Participated in two data center moves consisting of over 2000 VMs

positions.title: Business Process and Quality Analyst
positions.description:
Started as a Customer Service Representative, answering calls and responding to customer emails, with a focus on the Microsoft Partner Network. Served as a subject matter expert for agents, peers, and supervisors for both technical and program-related questions. Lead a team of eleven in launching one of the first Microsoft Online Services/Office 365 support centers in North America.

As a Business Process and Quality Analyst, I automated a number of processes and daily tasks to help improve the productivity of myself and my peers. Developed reporting tools for quality assurance and customer service used throughout the North America support centers. Worked with international offices to standardize internal processes resulting in full alignment of reporting for thirteen separate lines of business.

TECHNOLOGIES AND METHODOLOGIES:
- Python
- SAP
- Microsoft Excel and VBA
- Microsoft Power Point
- KANA
- RightNow CRM

ACHIEVEMENTS:
- COPC certification in Quality Assurance and Customer Service
- Engineered reporting tools which set the precedent for operational standards within
the company.

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description: Provided technical recommendations and support. Proceeded into a management position, involving opening and closing the store, committing price overrides as necessary, and working directly with top-spending customers to ensure that they received the highest level of service possible.
